name: opencode-plugin-dev
postCreateCommand:
echo 'vscode:vscode' | sudo chpasswd && npm install -g bun && git config --global user.name '${localEnv:GIT_AUTHOR_NAME}' && git config --global user.email '${localEnv:GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL}' && cd /workspaces/opencode-graph-plugin && bun install && mkdir -p ~/.config/opencode ~/.local/share/opencode ~/.local/state/opencode && sudo chown -R vscode:vscode ~/.config/opencode ~/.local/share/opencode ~/.local/state/opencode && printf '{"$schema":"https://opencode.ai/config.json","provider":{"deepseek":{"options":{"baseURL":"https://api.deepseek.com/v1","apiKey":"%s"}},"lmstudio":{"npm":"@ai-sdk/openai-compatible","name":"LM Studio (local)","options":{"baseURL":"http://host.docker.internal:1234/v1"},"models":{"google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-qat":{"name":"Gemma 4 26B (local)"},"qwen2.5-coder-14b-instruct":{"name":"Qwen2.5 Coder 14B (local)"},"qwen/qwen3.8-27b":{"name":"qwen/qwen3.8-27b (q2, local)"}, "qwen/qwen3.8-9b":{"name":"qwen/qwen3.8-9b"}, "text-embedding-nomic-embed-text-v1.5":{"name":"Nomic Embed (local)"}}}},"defaultProvider":"deepseek"}
' "${DEEPSEEK_API_KEY}" > ~/.config/opencode/config.json
